reference_question: Summarize the key information in this document.
user_question: Can you provide a summary of the key information in this product distribution form?
answer: This document, dated January 20, 1978, details the distribution plan for product FF1 (MRD #5546/478), a project originated by William Doyle. The form is addressed to multiple recipients from Loews and Greensboro. It specifies 33 states and 2 specific cities (Chicago and NYC) selected to receive the product. Seven product codes (741, 753, 827, 462, 519, 934, and 639) will be distributed in varying quantities, with most receiving 1920 packs and some receiving 960 packs. All products are in 20's pack size, and approximately 20% of each state's population will receive the product. The total distribution across all product codes is 11,520 packs. The distribution appears to focus more heavily on Eastern and Midwestern states than Southern and Western regions.
